entries.english:
Arnsburg: The brothers Eckard and Henne von Bleichenbach and Wiprecht von Rosenberg issue a receipt to Arnsburg Abbey for an annuity.

Formal description: Original, paper, with impressed seal.

(Provenance): Arnsburg Abbey.
